draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.81, the 195th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 10th of 13 at QB. He lasted until pick 231, well after his grade rank (195th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3,441 passing yards in 2019, 5th of 13 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2020. 3 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2020. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (3rd percentile).
